metadata.description: Shared Claude Code setup for the RAGStudio microservices

plugins.name: ragstudio-core
plugins.description: Architecture reference (ERD, events, internal APIs, business rules), docs-writer skill and agent with auto-docs hook, contract checker, PR and handoff workflows, read guard and session context hooks. Enable in every repo.

plugins.name: ragstudio-spring
plugins.description: Spring Boot 3.5 / Gradle / Java 21: endpoint, RabbitMQ and Flyway skills, reviewer and test-runner agents, format-on-edit and compile-on-stop hooks.

plugins.name: ragstudio-python
plugins.description: Python 3.12 / FastAPI / uv: endpoint, aio-pika and Alembic skills, reviewer and test-runner agents, Ruff format-on-edit and lint-on-stop hooks.
